Endocrinology

HOMA-IR

Estimate insulin resistance from fasting glucose and insulin.

Result

Enter values to calculate

Formula

HOMA-IR = (Glucose × Insulin) / 405

Clinical interpretation

  • Higher values suggest greater insulin resistance
  • Interpret with clinical context and lab reference ranges

Commonly used in metabolic syndrome and diabetes research.
